description: Election Commission - M. H. M. Nasar was Selected as the member of the Athanagalla Pradishiya Sabha - A. S. Hameed was Selected as the member the Kalmuna Municipal Council - M. M. Nasoordeen was Selected as the member the Kinniya Urban Council
reasoning: This gazette content deals specifically with filling vacancies in local government bodies (Attanagalla Pradeshiya Sabha, Kalmunai Municipal Council, and Kinniya Urban Council) due to resignations, under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It involves the electoral process for local authorities, including declarations by Returning Officers about selected members to fill vacant positions, which falls under the Elections category (Type 7) for electoral processes and related matters.
